</question>

'Covered Data' includes, but is not l

data.answer: Yes, lists of hazardous materials stored at DePaul are treated as covered data.

claims.text: 'Covered Data' includes, but is not limited, to those data items listed below: • Social security numbers ... • Lists of hazardous materials stored at DePaul • Insurance policy numbers
